import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    strings = data[1:]
    
    # Sort strings by length in descending order
    strings.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    
    # Initialize the maximum length of the subgroup
    max_length = 0
    
    # Iterate over each string to consider it as the potential "t"
    for i in range(n):
        current_length = 1
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if strings[i].endswith(strings[j]):
                current_length += 1
        max_length = max(max_length, current_length)
    
    print(max_length)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
